title: Topic 17
japanese_text:
A：来週の木曜日って大学の<u>創立</u>記念日？
B：うん、だから授業はないよね。でも、<u>必修</u>科目の<u>課題</u>が多すぎて休める気がしないよ。
english_translation: A: Isn’t next Thursday the anniversary of the university’s founding? B: Yes, so there won’t be any classes. But I don’t think I can take a day off because I have too many assignments to do for my required courses.
